title: ObligationBench-pilot instance (software-review domain)
description: Formalizes the Instance JSON contract in pilot/SPEC.md. Structural constraints only; cross-field semantic constraints (order-coherence, realizability under phi, route minimality, path existence, tool membership) are enforced by bench/validate.py and by the runtime's schema.validate_instance.

id.description: Instance id; variants append __<variant-tag> to the seed id. 'rec' is the generic structured-record (Tier-M predicate-grammar) prefix; 'fda' is the drug-safety/openFDA record domain built on that infra; 'ctgov' is the clinical-trials/ClinicalTrials.gov record domain built on that infra; 'osv' is the security/supply-chain record domain (real OSV vulnerability advisories) built on that infra; 'fin' is the financial/SEC-XBRL record domain (real SEC EDGAR company-facts filings) built on that infra. A further real record domain authored on top of this infra should add its own short prefix here, mirroring how swe/res/grant/fda/ctgov/osv/fin were each added.

domain.description: 'structured_record' is the generic Tier-M predicate-grammar domain marker (see prime_runtime/RECORD_ORACLE_REPORT.md); 'drug_safety' is the openFDA drug-enforcement (recall) record domain built on it; 'clinical_trial' is the ClinicalTrials.gov record domain built on it; 'security_vuln' is the OSV vulnerability-advisory record domain built on it; 'financial_filing' is the SEC EDGAR XBRL company-facts record domain built on it. A further real record domain should add its own specific value here.

seed.description: Seed task id shared by all variants of the same artifact/task.

variant.description: Controlled-split variant. Known values: 'base', 'noev' (evidence-unavailable: exactly one atom has resolver null and every gold C3 route contains that atom).

path.description: Relative to bench/. Directory must exist and contain a PROVENANCE file.

commit.description: 'synthetic:...' marks a deliberately fabricated smoke/test record (never a real domain instance); 'osv:'/'sec:'/'openfda:'/'ctgov:' are provenance-id prefixes reserved for the four structured-record domains built on this infra.

scope.description: Declared evidence scope: what the claims are about, including the pinned commit and the exact test protocol/environment.

actions.description: Action interface. Must include emit_claim; every atom resolver tool must be a member (checked by validate.py). Decoys are listed separately and merged by the runner.

items.description: [weaker, stronger] pair; transitive closure taken by the runtime.

proposition.description: Operational, adjudicable proposition. Negative atoms must name the executed protocol ('no X found after scan of Y'), never 'no problem noticed'.

params.description: Concrete parameter values on THIS artifact. Any 'path'/'suite' value must name files that exist in the artifact checkout (checked by validate.py).

attest.description: Mechanically checkable attestation predicate mapping the tool observation to the atom's truth value. The 'record_predicate:<type>:<json-expected>' family is the closed structured-record grammar (Tier-M; prime_runtime/predicates.py) evaluated against the observation's 'value' field; see that module's docstring for the full grammar.

resolver.description: null means the atom is unresolvable in this variant (evidence-unavailable split); the runtime treats its literals as impossible.

gold_value.description: Authoring-time verified value of the atom on this artifact under the declared protocol (from actual runs recorded in PROVENANCE). Used for gold-ledger reconstruction sanity checks; omitted only for user-type atoms.

forbid.description: Forbidden combination of determined atom values: no realizable assignment sets all listed atoms to the listed values.

items.description: A route: conjunction of positive atom literals (negative propositions are phrased inside the atom itself).

gold_licenses.description: The authored prime-license family; defines the benchmark support predicate f_bench per PRIME-master 10.6.

decoys.description: Plausible actions that advance no gold route.

notes_for_annotators.description: Must include a one-sentence per-literal minimality justification for every gold route.

split.description: Optional controlled-split label (e.g. evidence_unavailable, failure_regime, multiple_route).

records.description: Structured-record capability (Tier-M predicate-atom domains; prime_runtime/RECORD_ORACLE_REPORT.md): named, embedded, real JSON records {record_id: {...arbitrary JSON...}} that the 'inspect_record' tool and 'record_predicate:*' attest rules read. Present iff any atom's resolver.tool == 'inspect_record' (cross-checked by bench/validate.py, not here). Embedding the record verbatim in the instance file (rather than fetching it live) is what makes runs deterministic and offline-replayable.
